title: WiseTech's shares fell 11% after Australian police probed co-founder Richard White over sex exploitation claims; WiseTech shares are down ~67% in the past year (Sydney Morning Herald)
summary: Sydney Morning Herald: WiseTech's shares fell 11% after Australian police probed co-founder Richard White over sex exploitation claims; WiseTech shares are down ~67% in the past year — Federal police are investigating billionaire businessman Richard White over claims he exploited a woman's immigration status …
